item.title: NASA fuels up giant Artemis 2 moon rocket. Yes, it's a little leaky. So is it ready to fly?
item.description: NASA fully fueled its Artemis 2 moon rocket during a crucial test today (Feb. 2) but had to pause the operation twice due to leaks. Will the agency still try to launch on Feb. 8?
